The total ad revenue generated from users who installed or reinstalled your app within your selected timeframe up to the current date. It is cumulative and based on ad revenue reported by the Adjust SDK or recorded server-to-server. Example: If the selected time frame is Jan 1-31, and today is May 1st, the revenue is counted up to May 1st.
